title: Understanding the Capabilities, Limitations, and Societal Impact of Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: The paper is a summary of a workshop discussion rather than an empirical study. It discusses racial bias as a known issue in GPT-3 and proposes future evaluation and mitigation methods, including expansive suites of 'bias tests', red-teaming the model at scale, and reinforcement learning with human feedback.
